verdict.rationale: Dover documents a public API for programmatically adding candidates to jobs, fetching job listings, and automating recruitment processes, so the core of the story is delivered. The documented scope is thin, and probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any common path. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, a documented endpoint/auth reference covering the product's broader surface, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: With the API, you can programmatically add candidates to your jobs, fetch job listings, and automate various recruitment processes.
